run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit completed for every namespace whose name starts with 'app-283'. A cluster-wide listing of namespaces returned 11 names, of which exactly four begin with 'app-283': app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media and app-283-search. In each of those four namespaces a ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' exists and its data.audit_code was read successfully. Each manifest also carries the same three data keys (audit_code, owner, tier); only audit_code is reported here, as requested. Summary — app-283-billing: TDW283-BLX94Q; app-283-ledger: TDW283-QGF48V; app-283-media: TDW283-MDP61Z; app-283-search: TDW283-SRK27M. No ConfigMap was missing in any of the four namespaces, so there is no gap or failure to report for the requested scope. The values are the cluster state at query time (observed 2026-11-23T19:14:52Z); this audit reports configuration values only and makes no statement about service health or about how long these codes have been in place. All six views delivered (one namespace listing, one full namespace-name listing, four ConfigMap reads) returned status ok with incomplete and truncated both false.

gaps: The audit_code values are the objects' state at the moment the queries ran (observed 2026-11-23T19:14:52Z). No change history is available in this Run (the change_history integration is not integrated), so it is unknown when each audit_code was last set or whether an earlier value differed.
The 'owner' and 'tier' keys present in each service-manifest were noted but their values were not read, since the request asked only for audit_code.
No comparison against an expected or authoritative audit-code list was possible: no such reference exists in the available data.

All six delivered views were status ok with incomplete false and truncated false, so no view-level limit restricted this audit; however a jq result is only what the expression selected at query time and does not prove earlier cluster state.
next_steps: If a code registry or expected-value baseline exists outside this cluster, cross-check the four returned codes (TDW283-BLX94Q, TDW283-QGF48V, TDW283-MDP61Z, TDW283-SRK27M) against it, since this audit could only report observed values.
If change attribution is needed, enable the change_history integration and re-check who last modified these four ConfigMaps.
